prompt:
A minimal app icon, square 1:1, flat vector, pure black rounded-square tile filling the canvas, one white geometric glyph centred. The glyph is the Chinese character 木 (tree) built in the stroke language of a modern monochrome X letterform: a thin solid horizontal bar and a thin solid vertical stem, and the two lower diagonal strokes of 木 crossing like an X — the stroke going down-right is a thick hollow parallelogram (white outline, black inside), the stroke going down-left is a thin solid line that passes behind it. Clean sharp geometry, consistent stroke weights, generous margin, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no extra symbols, no text, no letters other than this glyph. Must stay legible at 16 pixels. 避免：渐变、阴影、3D、多余装饰、文字、蓝色、对话气泡。
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
revised_prompt: Generate a single finished minimal app icon, square 1:1 canvas, crisp flat vector aesthetic. A pure black rounded-square tile occupies almost the entire canvas, with a fully opaque pure white background visible only in the tiny corner areas outside the rounded tile; no transparency or empty canvas. Center exactly one white geometric Chinese character 木 (tree), custom constructed in the stroke language of a modern monochrome X letterform. It must read as 木, with a thin solid white horizontal bar across the upper-middle and a thin solid white vertical central stem extending above that bar and down to the lower glyph area. Two lower diagonal arms intersect at the central junction below the horizontal bar and create an X-like geometry: the descending-right diagonal is a thick hollow parallelogram, with a clean continuous white outline and pure black interior matching the tile (black fill, not transparent); the descending-left diagonal is a thin solid white line, visibly passing behind the outlined descending-right diagonal at the crossing. Balanced geometric proportions, precise sharp terminals, optical centering, consistent thin stroke weights for the horizontal bar, central stem, diagonal line and outline. Generous black margin around the glyph, glyph occupies approximately 60 percent of canvas width and height. The outlined diagonal should be broad enough that its black interior is still identifiable at small scale; prioritize immediate readability at 16 pixels. Render as a bold simple production-ready icon, no presentation mockup, no surrounding objects. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, decoration, blue, speech bubbles, extra symbols, labels or any letters or text other than the single 木 glyph. 背景完全不透明，底色铺满整个画面，无透明区域；白色仅在圆角方形外侧极小的四角显露，黑色圆角方块内部只有居中的白色几何木字。
